name: Agmond's Fate
label: Quest
description: Agmond's Fate: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead! He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside Uldaman. I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.
I need you to get those urns for our studies. Go to the Uldaman site, gather the urns, then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find those urns, friend? We must find the link between them and the troggs!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! With luck and diligence, we will find whatever link exists between the troggs and these ancient artifacts.
You have done a great deed for the Prospectors, friend. Your efforts will not be forgotten. And neither will Agmond.
